reuse_rule: Reuse every G9 reconstructed full locale and supplement exactly. G10 changes no JEI English key/value, no Minecraft language inventory, and no JEI language resource file.
debug_keys: Retain the exact G9 behavior: debug-only description.jei.* entries remain target English in full addon files and are never emitted in supplements.
norwegian_policy: Minecraft-facing no_no remains a full addon locale. JEI nb_no is preserved independently and is not treated as an alias.
release_rule: Minecraft 1.12.1 must receive its own dedicated JAR; never combine it with Minecraft 1.12, 1.12.2 or another version.
